mapper.select: SELECT count(MESSAGE_MST_NO) AS cnt FROM ${main_table} WHERE MESSAGE_STATUS_CD = '00' AND SEND_TYPE_CD IN ('K1','M1','M2','99') AND ( ETRS_MTCD = '01' OR (ETRS_MTCD = '02' AND TO_TIMESTAMP(SEND_EXPECTED_DT || SEND_EXPECTED_TIME, 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS') <= SYSTIMESTAMP) )

SELECT MESSAGE_MST_NO FROM ${main_table} WHERE MESSAGE_STATUS_CD = '00' AND SEND_TYPE_CD IN ('K1','M1','M2','99') AND ( ETRS_MTCD = '01' OR (ETRS_MTCD = '02' AND TO_TIMESTAMP(SEND_EXPECTED_DT || SEND_EXPECTED_TIME, 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS') <= SYSTIMESTAMP) ) ORDER BY ETRS_MTCD ASC, SEND_EXPECTED_DT ASC, SEND_EXPECTED_TIME ASC FETCH FIRST 500 ROWS ONLY
